Reverify this criterion: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 100+2*10 and 100+2*20 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to Analog Devices.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An IF interferer may be an image or an intermodulation product; vary LO in an offline frequency table and test the 2IF location.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 輸入表應能唯一重建式 100+2*10 與 100+2*20，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 Analog Devices 的規格。

steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：輸入表應能唯一重建式 100+2*10 與 100+2*20，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 Analog Devices 的規格。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：能推導並解釋120 MHz與140 MHz，建立frequency_plan.csv、欲收/鏡像兩條路徑、預選器查核表，並完成以下驗收：預選器必須在鏡像頻率提供題設所需抑制；提高IF只改變濾波難度，不能單憑鏡像遠離宣告合格。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
frequency_plan.csv, desired/image paths and a preselector checklist. All numbers, budgets and thresholds are synthetic educational assumptions, not system specifications or service guarantees. Use offline calculation or simulation without operating a transmitter.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 100+2*10 and 100+2*20 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to Analog Devices.

Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：混頻差頻為abs(fRF-fLO)。高側注入下，欲收與鏡像都可落入同一IF，IF濾波器無法事後分離。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：欲收100 MHz，IF=10 MHz；高側LO=110 MHz。改用IF=20 MHz時LO=120 MHz；計算高側鏡像。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: A difference mixer produces abs(fRF-fLO); with high-side injection, desired and image RF can share an IF and cannot be separated afterward by the IF filter. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Receive 100 MHz with IF=10 MHz and LO=110 MHz; then use IF=20 MHz and LO=120 MHz and calculate the high-side image. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
